name: WISDM

protocol.note: Raw time-series data. Methods must implement sliding window segmentation with the specified window size and stride.

description: 36 subjects performed 6 activities (Walking, Jogging, Upstairs, Downstairs, Sitting, Standing) with a smartphone accelerometer in their pocket recording at 20Hz. The data is provided as a continuous raw stream. The task is to segment the stream into 10 second windows with 50% overlap and classify each window into one of the 6 activities. Train on subjects 1 to 30. Test on subjects 31 to 36. Class imbalance is significant. Walking and Jogging have many more samples than stationary activities.
